defects.name: direct_engine_mutation_bypasses_commit_channel
defects.description: LGAEEngine still publicly exposes multiple direct mutation paths. evolution.py contains 'self.graph = shadow' inside the legacy evaluate_and_maybe_commit() path. The runtime exposes rt.engine publicly. Direct mutation is not physically prevented, only conventionally avoided by canonical code.
defects.fix_approach: Make engine private (_engine). Return read-only facade for backward compat. Capability-gate all mutation methods.

defects.name: commit_channel_only_logically_exclusive
defects.description: CommitChannel.commit() is the intended sole mutation path, but nothing prevents calling engine.evaluate_and_maybe_commit() directly. The invariant is 'canonical code tries to use CommitChannel' rather than 'authoritative state cannot be modified except through CommitChannel'.
defects.fix_approach: Require _AuthorityCapability token for all mutation methods. Generate exactly one token. No external code can produce it.

defects.name: graph_fiber_gauge_apply_is_non_atomic
defects.description: CommitChannel._apply() sequentially performs graph replacement, fiber restore, gauge copy. If fiber restore raises after graph state changed, graph remains changed. Seqlock provides read consistency, not transactional rollback.
defects.fix_approach: Pre-build complete StateBundle, validate, single pointer swap. Or capture full pre-state and rollback on exception.

defects.name: wal_records_graph_but_not_complete_transaction_state
defects.description: WAL WRITE records serialize only graph deltas (shadow_graph_state). No equivalent serialization of fiber, gauge, calibration, or model deltas. Recovery can only replay graph state, not full transactions.
defects.fix_approach: Serialize all transaction components into WAL. TX_PREPARE record contains full transaction.

defects.name: wal_commit_occurs_after_live_mutation
defects.description: WAL ordering is BEGIN → WRITE → APPLY GRAPH → APPLY FIBER → APPLY GAUGE → COMMIT. If process dies after partial apply but before COMMIT, recovery discards the transaction, but authoritative state was already partially mutated in memory.
defects.fix_approach: Construct complete new state in shadow memory before PREPARE. Swap atomically after PREPARE+fsync. COMMIT after swap.

defects.name: wal_counters_reset_on_reopen
defects.description: WriteAheadLog.__init__() initializes _lsn=0 and _next_txn_id=0 without scanning existing log. Reopening an existing WAL can reuse txn_id=0, lsn=1 after prior transactions already used them.
defects.fix_approach: Scan existing records on init. Set next_lsn = max_lsn + 1, next_txn_id = max_txn_id + 1.

defects.name: crash_tests_do_not_kill_inside_transaction_stages
defects.description: Existing crash tests kill after complete step() iterations, not inside commit transaction stages. The dangerous crash points (after BEGIN, after WRITE, after graph apply, after fiber apply, before COMMIT) are not tested.
defects.fix_approach: Add injectable failpoints inside CommitChannel. Use subprocess + SIGKILL at each failpoint.

defects.name: fiber_delta_fallback_uses_python_hash
defects.description: FiberDelta.to_hash() contains fallback 'str(hash(self.shadow_fiber_snapshot))' which reintroduces Python hash() nondeterminism into transaction identity.
defects.fix_approach: Remove hash() fallback. Require state_hash() or canonical serialization. Raise TypeError if unsupported.

defects.name: authorization_binding_is_optional_incomplete
defects.description: CommitChannel validates authorization binding only 'if transaction.authorization_id is not None'. A transaction with authorization_id=None skips the binding check. AuthorizationResult does not contain the transaction binding digest.
defects.fix_approach: Make binding mandatory (non-nullable). AuthorizationResult must contain transaction_hash. Commit requires exact equality.

defects.name: fiber_gauge_evaluation_still_mutate_and_restore
defects.description: Canonical evaluate() handles graph mutations via shadow evaluation, but fiber and gauge actions still use legacy mutate-and-restore patterns. Gauge evaluation directly changes raw_generators before capturing/restoring.
defects.fix_approach: Build ShadowState for all components. Apply candidates to shadow only. Zero authoritative mutation during evaluation.

defects.name: learn_uses_predicted_delta_as_realized_reward
defects.description: learn() records predicted_delta as the learning signal via record_outcome(..., predicted_delta). This creates self-confirming learning. The correct signal is realized_delta = U_after - U_before.
defects.fix_approach: Capture u_before during observation, u_after after commit. Use realized_delta = u_after - u_before for record_outcome.

defects.name: calibration_compares_delta_prediction_against_absolute_utility
defects.description: calibrator.update(predicted_delta, u_now) compares a delta prediction against an absolute utility level. Dimensionally incorrect. Should compare predicted_delta against realized_delta.
defects.fix_approach: Use calibrator.update(predicted_delta, realized_delta) where both are deltas.

defects.name: hierarchical_credit_not_connected
defects.description: CreditAssignment only sets outcome_credit=float(u_now). The hierarchical credit fields (diagnostic, candidate, planner, action, governance, prediction) are not populated. Standalone credit modules exist but are not integrated into the canonical transition.
defects.fix_approach: Populate all credit fields from actual subsystem outcomes. Make credit attribution observable and testable.

defects.name: performance_measured_can_mean_nothing_executed
defects.description: measure_tier() returns status=MEASURED even when all workload functions are None. Result can be 0ms latency with MEASURED status without measuring anything. No INVALID or PASS/FAIL statuses. No SLO thresholds.
defects.fix_approach: Add NOT_RUN, INVALID, PASS, FAIL statuses. Return INVALID when no workload executes. Add explicit SLO thresholds.

defects.name: hypothesis_missing_from_dev_dependencies
defects.description: pyproject.toml dev dependencies include pytest and pytest-cov but not hypothesis. Property-based tests (test_v510_metamorphic.py, test_v510_property_based.py) fail with ModuleNotFoundError. Clean pip install -e '.[dev]' cannot reproduce the advertised suite.

defects.name: release_manifest_stale
defects.description: Manifest verifier reports 'file count mismatch: manifest=169, actual=496'. The manifest has not been regenerated for v5.11. DEFECT-007 from v5.10 remains unresolved.
defects.fix_approach: Regenerate manifest from staged release tree. Every intentional file gets sha256+size entry.

defects.name: build_report_remains_v5_9_719_tests
defects.description: BUILD_REPORT.md still says 'LGAE v5.9.0 Build Report' and '719 tests'. Release provenance is internally inconsistent with the actual v5.11-dev build.
defects.fix_approach: Generate BUILD_REPORT_v5.11.0.md from machine-generated artifacts. Report actual files, tests, gates, and limitations.

defects.name: final_qualification_asserts_symbols_not_invariants
defects.description: test_v511_final_qualification.py uses assertions like 'assert CommitChannel is not None' for 'single authoritative mutation channel proven'. These are existence checks, not behavioral proofs. Method names say *_proven but assertions don't prove the properties.
defects.fix_approach: Replace symbol existence checks with actual behavioral assertions. Call hostile integration tests or verify generated qualification artifacts.

defects.name: four_real_graph_benchmarks_remain_synthetic_surrogates
defects.description: Dolphin, Les Misérables, PolBooks, and Football are still synthetic BA approximations. File exposes is_real_data=False but enum/function name still says RealGraphBenchmark. Scientific qualification should treat these as surrogates, not real OOD evidence.
defects.fix_approach: Rename to *_SIZE_SURROGATE. Separately support canonical datasets with full provenance. Do not mix real and surrogate results.
